axioms: 'Attempt' (retries at current tier) and 'tier' (position in the sonnet→opus→fable ladder) must be tracked as orthogonal dimensions; conflating them into one counter violates two-strikes-per-tier semantics.
The escalation state machine must be provably terminating, with a worst-case bound like len(TierSequence) * MaxRetriesPerTier.
retry.go copies Model: orig.Model verbatim; tier-stepping is a new code path (a new function or changed signature), not an incremental 'extension'.
The existing MaxRetries=3 default truncates the ladder before the second escalation can be evaluated unless explicitly re-scoped.
Verdict-parse failure must fail-closed (unparseable → error/escalate, not retry), or a broken executor burns the same-tier retry budget without ever escalating.
The oscillation guard depends on a durable chain identity that survives re-triggers; walking ParentDispatchID from an ephemeral dispatch root resets the escalation cap to zero on every re-run.
failure_mode: Assumes routing resolves the correct model in the first place — does not review precedence/resolution correctness (owned by routing-kernel-mechanics).
Stops at whether the escalation event is correctly triggered/capped/recorded; does not judge whether the recorded data aggregates into a sound metric.
Reasons about termination and counters mechanically; does not reach into human-allocation-independence or flow-spillway metaphors, nor statistical sufficiency of the resulting sample.
